clips.caption:
Most people wait to feel confident before they go after money. Kevin Trudeau says that's backwards.

He explains self-image decides the outcome before anything happens: two people get the identical opportunity, and the one who believes he's worthy succeeds while the other, who doesn't, finds a way to fail.

Then he names the real disease behind most failure: excusitis. Losers are great at one thing - making excuses. Winners take responsibility instead, even when the start is bad.

Confidence doesn't come first. It comes from acting like you already have it.

What's the excuse you've been making today?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #moneymindset #selfbelief #successhabits #wealthmindset

Most people treat changing their mind as weakness - especially once they've said something out loud.

Kevin Trudeau points to two of the smartest men who ever lived: Albert Einstein and Stephen Hawking both said the same thing - when the facts change, I change my mind.

Most of us do the opposite. We decide once, then spend years defending that decision so we don't look wrong, even after the circumstances that made it true are gone.

That's not conviction. That's ego protecting an old opinion.

What decision have you been defending out of pride instead of facts?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #criticalthinking #selfimprovement #success #growthmindset

clips.end_words: There's no end to the movie
clips.caption:
Most people are waiting for one moment to finally feel happy - the house, the relationship, the bank balance.

Kevin Trudeau says that moment never actually arrives. He calls it the Disney lie: there's no happily-ever-after scene where the story just stops and you finally relax.

The journey is the reward, not the destination. Chase a goal while telling yourself you'll feel good once you get there, and you'll arrive and feel exactly the same - just looking for the next thing.

The only fix is deciding to feel good now, before anything changes.

What are you waiting to have before you let yourself feel good?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #journeyoverdestination #successmindset #motivation #wealthmindset
